bullets.title: Festina lente
bullets.note: _Festina lente_ or _speûde bradéōs_ (σπεῦδε βραδέως) is a classical adage and oxymoron meaning “make haste slowly.” It has been adopted as a motto numerous times, particularly by the emperors Augustus and Titus, then later by the Medicis and the Onslows. ([Wikipedia](https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Festina_lente))
